title: Machine interpreting competitiveness: a discourse-sensitive comparison of meaning and target-language quality in English-Chinese simultaneous interpreting
abstract: arXiv:2611.19802v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Machine interpreting (MI), or AI-enabled speech translation, is increasingly visible in professional and public-facing communication, yet its performance relative to human simultaneous interpreters remains insufficiently understood. Existing studies are often limited by a single discourse mode and evaluation frameworks that are not well aligned with interpreting as a discourse-level communicative activity. The present study compares five commercial MI systems with 26 human interpreters (14 professionals, 12 advanced students) on English-to-Chinese simultaneous interpreting across planned and unplanned discourse, focusing on meaning and target-language quality. In these materials, MI performance differed sharply between the two discourse modes. In the planned formal speech, the strongest system became highly competitive on meaning, entering the upper human range, and a second system also performed strongly. In the extemporaneous interview

translated_title: 机器口译的竞争力：英汉同声传译中意义与译语质量的语篇敏感性比较
translated_abstract: 机器口译（MI），即人工智能驱动的语音翻译，在专业及面向公众的交流中日益常见，但其相对于人类同声传译员的表现仍缺乏充分认识。现有研究往往受限于单一的语篇模式，且评估框架与口译作为一种语篇层面交际活动的特点契合度不足。本研究将五个商用机器口译系统与26名人类口译员（14名职业译员、12名高年级学生译员）在英译汉同声传译任务上的表现进行比较，涵盖计划性与非计划性语篇，重点关注意义传达与译语质量。在这些材料中，机器口译在两种语篇模式下的表现差异显著。在计划性的正式演讲中，表现最强的系统在意义传达方面极具竞争力，进入了人类译员的较高水平区间，另一系统也表现强劲。在即兴访谈中……
tldr: 本研究采用语篇敏感的评估框架，将五个商用机器口译系统与26名人类译员在英汉同声传译中的意义传达与译语质量进行比较，发现机器口译在计划性正式语篇中已进入人类译员较高水平区间，但在即兴语篇中表现差异显著。
en_tdlr: This discourse-sensitive comparison of five commercial machine interpreting systems and 26 human interpreters in English-Chinese simultaneous interpreting reveals that the strongest MI system becomes highly competitive in meaning accuracy for planned formal speech, entering the upper human range, while performance differs sharply across discourse modes.
